title: Night flash with a yuzu tonic

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. Paparazzi-style night flash on a city pavement: he walks straight at the lens, cracking open the violet can with one hand, the print lit hard by a direct on-camera flash. Behind him the shopfronts smear into warm streaks from a slow shutter. He wears an oversized charcoal bomber over a white T-shirt, black straight-leg trousers and black leather loafers. 28mm, framed from the knees up, a candid half-smile, hair lifted by the breeze.
